title: 1700-1706 Prairie's dormers get their classical pediments
items: Each roof dormer on the Glessner townhouses now has a pediment like the ones in Chicagology's photograph. It has a moulded cornice that wraps round the dormer's sides, a raking cornice up both slopes, and a lower, classical pitch.
Slim pilasters with capitals frame each pair of windows. The dormers' sides are painted white like their faces, as the photographs print them, and are no longer slated.
